caption: The drawing is rectangular and set on a light tan background, featuring a central heart shape bordered with multiple concentric outline bands in red, green, and blue. Inside the heart, there is text with some portions filled in with names and dates, written in brown ink. Above the heart is more cursive text, and above that, a small circular motif divided into four segments, colored mainly in red, green, and yellow. Each corner at the top and bottom of the drawing contains a quarter-circle segment with red, green, and blue concentric arcs. The left and right edges of the main composition are bordered by a red and brown wavy line. Below the central heart and to its left and right are two small potted floral motifs with brown pots, green stems, and hints of red on the flowers. Below the heart, at the drawing’s bottom, there is a large semicircular arch pattern with segments colored in red, green, and blue along with a laurel garland design arching over it. The overall palette uses muted shades of red, blue, green, brown, and tan with all motifs contained by a rectangular green border.
title: Pa. German Birth Certificate
